name: Character Landing Page
tagline: Turn one picture into a landing page with a character that watches your cursor and poses as you scroll.
youSay: /character-landing Make a landing page for my plush fox mascot, Miso. Here's the picture: ~/Desktop/miso.png
whatYouGet: A static website: a big hero character whose eyes follow the cursor, then four scenes where it strikes a new pose as you scroll
A colour palette, font pairing and copy chosen to suit the character
Plain HTML, CSS and JS you can host anywhere
goodFit: Mascots, plush toys, illustrated characters and stylised self-portraits
Product launches, portfolios and personal sites that need personality
youBring: One reference image (photo, drawing or illustration)
